_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::multiscale#7. The entry told an agent to 'use the MULTISCALE micro-output writer (separate VTU per Gauss point)' without naming it. It is RUNTIMEOUTPUT_GP, a key on MAT_Struct_Multiscale taking all / none / first_gp_only, and what it emits is one whole output tree per Gauss point named res_microdis<N>_el<E>_gp<G>-vtk-files/ — the naming is the only way to tell which RVE a file belongs to, so the fixture asserts a concrete example of it. Flipping MAT 1 from all to none on upstream sohex8_multiscale_macro drops the per-Gauss-point trees from 26 to 2; both arms exit 0, both pass all three result tests, and nothing is printed about the micro output being off. That is the trap: an agent who never sets the key gets a clean, complete, silent run with the micro scale simply absent. Each arm runs in its own directory because 4C writes VTU trees relative to the working directory. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave RUNTIMEOUTPUT_GP at 'all' in the second arm. Both arms then emit 26 per-Gauss-point trees, NONE_GP_TREES becomes 26, and the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: sed 's/      RUNTIMEOUTPUT_GP: all/      RUNTIMEOUTPUT_GP: none/' macro.yaml > d_none/macro.yaml
